```{r}
#| echo: false

card_id <- paste0("card-", gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "-", data$name))
collapse_id <- paste0("collapse-", card_id)

div(
  class = "accordion-item",
  div(
    class = "accordion-header",
    id = paste0("heading-", card_id),
    h4(
      class = "accordion-button collapsed d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center",
      `data-bs-toggle` = "collapse",
      `data-bs-target` = paste0("#", collapse_id),
      `aria-expanded` = "false",
      `aria-controls` = collapse_id,
      div(
        data$name,
        span(
          class = "badge bg-secondary ms-2",
          sprintf("Count: %d", data$count)
        )
      )
    )
  ),
  div(
    id = collapse_id,
    class = "accordion-collapse collapse",
    `aria-labelledby` = paste0("heading-", card_id),
    `data-bs-parent` = "#intersection-accordion",
    div(
      class = "accordion-body",
      p(class = "card-text text-muted", data$set_indicators),
      if (length(data$elements) > 0) {
        if ( ! label == 'protein'){
            datatable(
            data.frame(Elements = data$elements),
            options = list(
              pageLength = 5,
              dom = 'Bfrtip',
              scrollY = "200px",
              scrollCollapse = TRUE,
              buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel'),
              language = list(
                search = 'Filter:',
                info = 'Showing _START_ to _END_ of _TOTAL_ elements'
              )
            ),
            extensions = 'Buttons',
            rownames = FALSE,
            class = 'cell-border stripe hover'
          )
        }else{
          datatable(
            data.frame(Peptide = data$elements, Protein_Ids = data$proteins, Description = data$protein_description  ),
            options = list(
              pageLength = 20,
              dom = 'Bfrtip',
              scrollY = "200px",
              scrollCollapse = TRUE,
              buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel'),
              language = list(
                search = 'Filter:',
                info = 'Showing _START_ to _END_ of _TOTAL_ elements'
              )
            ),
            extensions = 'Buttons',
            rownames = FALSE,
            class = 'cell-border stripe hover'
          )
        }
      } else {
        p("No elements in this intersection")
      }
    )
  )
)
```
